start: ^You look at a single man, scribe, and you see a moral puzzle. I look at this city and I see an entire nation facing absolute erasure.
^If the legions move to clear these courts, Sinai becomes a memory. It is expedient that one man should die for the people.
^Do you understand the weight of this chair?
^Is justice something that can be bartered for national security?
^What if the witnesses contradict each other at the trial?
security: ^Without a nation, there is no altar. Without an altar, there is no law. Order is the highest form of justice we can offer under Rome.
trial: ^We will hear them all. The truth will reveal itself, but the public safety verdict cannot be delayed.
